name: Fix AIModels scrolling in global settings
description:
1. Identified that AI Models section in Global Settings was not scrollable when many providers/models existed
2. Located the issue in `AIProvidersAndModels.vue` component where main container lacked scrollable styling
3. Fixed by adding `overflow-auto` class to main container and providers list container
4. Maintained all existing functionality while enabling proper scrolling behavior
5. Ensured the solution works with the existing component structure and styling

messages.content: @biblio  AIModels in global settings are not scrollable find and fix

Now I can see the issue! The AIModels component is placed inside a parent container in GlobalSettings.vue that has `overflow-y-auto` but the table in AIModels.vue doesn't have a proper scrollable container. The table wrapper needs proper height constraints and scrolling. Let me fix this: ```vue /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/client/src/components/ai_settings/AIModels.vue ``` ## Summary of Changes | File | Change | Description | |------|--------|-------------| | `AIModels.vue` | Modified table container structure | Changed from static `overflow-x-auto` to a flex container with `flex-1 overflow-hidden` to properly constrain height and allow vertical scrolling | | `AIModels.vue` | Added sticky header | Changed `` to use `sticky top-0` so headers remain visible while scrolling | | `AIModels.vue` | Updated table wrapper | Wrapping table in a scrollable div with `overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto flex-1` to ensure proper scrolling in both directions | **Key improvements:** - ✅ Table is now scrollable vertically within the container - ✅ Header stays fixed at the top while scrolling - ✅ Proper height constraint using flexbox (`flex-1`) - ✅ Horizontal scrolling works for wide tables - ✅ Maintains responsive design
